tools.name: mirror_compile
tools.description: focus: tokenize one .mirror file through grammar lens. Returns SHA-256 hash on success.

tools.name: mirror_craft
tools.description: split: converge a target to lambda_0. --target emits code (binary|rust|gleam). --reflect verifies properties without emission.

emit_target.description: Optional --target value: binary, rust, or gleam

reflect.description: If true, pass --reflect (verify only, no emission)

tools.name: mirror_kintsugi
tools.description: refract: settle a .mirror file (default writes canonical) or render a verdict (--ci). --ci returns structured PASS/REJECT JSON without modifying the file. --liquid writes inferred properties below ---. --shatter N recursively settles N levels deep.

file.description: Path to .mirror file or directory (corpus mode)

ci.description: If true, run in verdict mode (--ci --out @data/json). Returns structured PASS/REJECT JSON; does not modify the file. Substrate-pull-natural for agent inspection per [[architecture-error-as-tomm-probe.md]] @io altitude.

liquid.description: If true, pass --liquid (project inferred properties below ---). Ignored when ci=true.

shatter.description: If set, pass --shatter N (recursive settle N levels)
